ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportAtrybutyTypuListaZawartosc' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportAtrybutyTypuListaZawartosc;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportAtrybutyTypuListaZawartosc] @rowVersion bigint AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
SELECT (select max(AtW_CzasModyfikacji) from cdn.AtrybutyWartosci join cdn.atrybutyklasy on AtW_AtKId=atk_id where AtK_Wielowart = 0) AS [@RowVersion] ,( select AtW_ID as [@Id], AtW_AtKId as [@AttributeClassId], case when AtK_Format like '@s%' then AtW_ID else null end as [@ValueId], case when AtK_Format like '@s%' then null else AtW_Wartosc end as [@Value] from cdn.AtrybutyWartosci join cdn.atrybutyklasy on AtW_AtKId=atk_id where AtW_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion and AtK_Wielowart = 0 for xml path('Value'), type) for xml path('ListAttributeValues') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportAtrybutyTypuListaZawartosc TO CDNRaport
